units.source_text: 当然，秀男也是大友的长子。

en.t: Of course, Hideo was also Otomo's eldest son.

units.source_text: 他父亲宗助曾说过，秀男的手艺比自己棒。

en.t: His father, Sosuke, had once said that Hideo was more skilled than he was.

units.source_text: 不过，宗助还有老二、老三嘛。

en.t: However, Sosuke still had a second son and a third son as well.
